concepts.name: Plover
concepts.idea: Небольшая птица с узнаваемым силуэтом: дружелюбный софт, который остаётся привычным спутником.
concepts.wordmark: custom friendly lowercase rounded sans, tight even spacing, soft open p and e
concepts.mark: a tiny plover shorebird in profile reduced to THREE bold flat shapes: oval body, long single leg, short pointed beak; a cut in the body becomes the letter p; absolutely NOT owl, fox, play triangle or generic social-media bird
concepts.ui: pale coral-pink chrome, deep ink typography and neutral white content, compact left navigation with rounded active rows; warm rounded 12px thumbnails; a compact right Now playing panel showing track cover and controls, two wide Continue watching cards and a short row of albums; one small bird silhouette in the title bar and empty-state only, no mascot invasion
concepts.composition: left vertical coral-pink identity strip takes 24 percent, main app straight-on to its right takes 72 percent; small icon specimens and wordmark in strip, unusually warm approachable utilitarian software
concepts.risk: Есть одноимённая программа стенографии Plover; требует проверки сходства.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand and ui-mockup. Produce ONE highly resolved flat 16:10 brand-direction board for the existing native Windows video AND audio player being renamed from Lumen. This is an international consumer software identity exploration. Exact name: "Plover". It must read as a real scalable software brand, not a generic logo exercise.

ALL FOUR input images are reference-only screenshots of the current SAME product and must inform THIS concept: 1 existing home library, 2 real settings, 3 real music playback, 4 real video playback. Preserve real capabilities: own local media library, video, audio, playlists, network streams, recent items, search, resume, compact controls. You may redesign hierarchy, navigation arrangement, typographic proportions, spacing and shape for this identity; do not merely recolour the reference. All ten variants must have very different visual language, so commit strongly to this specific direction. Do not copy the previous Lumen play-and-arc icon. No old brand name. No subscriptions, user account avatars, likes, social feeds, cloud sync, streaming catalog, invented statistics, AI, decorative dashboards or charts.

Show ONE dominant straight-on actual desktop Home screen using the SAME demo collection: films "Northbound", "Low Tide", "After Hours", albums "Glasshouse", "Stillwater", "Night Transit". Muted photographic stills (winter road, quiet sea, city at night) and abstract nonbranded album covers. Media imagery remains its own colour, never globally tinted to match the brand. English UI labels must be short: "Home", "Videos", "Music", "Network", "Playlists", "Recent", "Continue watching", "Listen again", "Search". A neutral native Windows titlebar with minimize, maximize, close. No browser URL bar. Typography crisp enough to read. The app takes at least 68 percent of the canvas. Include the brand name in app titlebar, one small repeated brand mark, a separate large wordmark and mark, one realistic app icon and a small monochrome mark specimen. All repetitions of the mark must be exactly consistent.

TEXT: exact brand name "Plover" / lowercase "plover" where appropriate. Optional single category label "MEDIA PLAYER". No explanatory paragraphs, no fake metrics or descriptive slogans. Strong hierarchy and whitespace. Realistic native desktop application, design quality of a careful independent software studio. This is one independent concept, NOT a contact sheet of alternatives.
